rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is allowed to do something or for making a polite request.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 co5 ni1 dou6 maa3

rows.note: Use this to say that something is possible or that someone may be doing something.

example.english: They may still be at home.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ho2 nang4 zung6 hai2 uk1 kei2
